description: This file defines the VehicleAdapter class, a RecyclerView.Adapter implementation for displaying vehicle-related data in a list, along with the VehicleHolder ViewHolder class. It manages a list of vehicle items and binds data to views for display in an Android application.

classes.name: VehicleAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for a RecyclerView to display a list of vehicle items, managing creation and binding of VehicleHolder views.

classes.name: VehicleHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class that holds references to the views for each vehicle list item, specifically the header and value TextViews.

methods.name: VehicleAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a list of vehicle data items.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and inflates the layout for each vehicle item and returns a VehicleHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from the vehicle list to the views in the VehicleHolder at the given position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of vehicle items in the list.

methods.name: VehicleHolder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view references for a vehicle list item.
